title: CareerOS Note
description: A schema for representing a note or annotation within CareerOS.

id.description: A stable identifier for the note.

category.description: The category or topic of the note.

visibility.description: The intended visibility of the note.

relatedEntity.description: A reference to the entity associated with the note.

content.description: The body content of the note.

metadata.description: Lifecycle and governance metadata for the note record.
